metadata.licenseNotes: Original CyberMentor instructional synthesis with reference links to authoritative public sources; no source page is republished.

artifact.title: Reconstruct a simulated insider incident from an evidence bundle.
artifact.scenario: an investigator must reconstruct activity on a simulated workstation after a suspected insider event
requirements: Define scope, authorization, assumptions, and measurable success criteria.
Collect and interpret source identifiers, acquisition notes, hashes, timestamps, metadata, timeline entries, and chain-of-custody records.
Compare at least two response or design options and explain the tradeoff.
Recommend a bounded defensive action and a verification plan.
Document limitations, residual risk, cleanup, and next steps.

rubric.exemplary: Defines authorization, assets, assumptions, constraints, and success criteria precisely.
rubric.meets: Defines the main scope and assumptions with minor gaps that do not invalidate the work.

rubric.exemplary: Uses traceable evidence, considers alternatives, and clearly separates observation from inference.
rubric.meets: Uses relevant evidence and provides a defensible reasoning chain.

rubric.exemplary: Proposes bounded remediation, validates outcome and side effects, and records residual risk.
rubric.meets: Proposes a proportionate action and verifies the intended result.

rubric.exemplary: Produces a concise, reproducible report suited to technical and business stakeholders.
rubric.meets: Communicates the decision, evidence, outcome, and limitations clearly.

expectedEvidence: At least one explicit verification result
A statement of limitations and residual risk
learnerConstraints: Use only bundled fictional or personally owned authorized evidence.
Remove secrets, personal data, and real target identifiers.
Do not reproduce proprietary course or employer material.
mentorBoundaries: Sentinel may explain concepts and question assumptions.
Sentinel may not write the final submission or provide graded answers.
